dict.string: MacTap needs Accessibility access to send keyboard shortcuts and control other applications when you tap the chassis.
MacTap sends AppleEvents to run AppleScripts and Shortcuts when you tap the chassis.
MacTap can control media playback when you tap the chassis.
MacTap needs Input Monitoring access to detect keyboard input for simulating tap gestures.
MacTap uses the MacBook's built-in motion sensors to detect physical taps on the chassis and trigger your custom actions.
MacTap needs permission to perform system actions like screenshots and media control when you tap the chassis.
MacTap may send notifications when gestures are detected.
